title: AI’s most important protocol is getting a little bit easier to use
description: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is one of the basic building blocks of AI interoperability, giving AI models a secure way to access external data sources and services. It’s the plumbing that lets a chatbot reach into your calendar, your database, or your internal tools, instead of engineers building custom pipes for every connection. Next […]
summary_cn: Model Context Protocol (MCP) 作为AI互操作性的基础协议，近期得到易用性改进。该协议为AI模型提供安全访问外部数据源（日历、数据库、内部工具）的标准接口，无需工程师逐一集成。对产品经理而言，MCP降低了AI功能与现有系统的连接成本，加速了企业内部工具、CRM、数据库等场景的AI落地，并有望成为行业标准，提升AI产品的扩展性和商业价值。
